overview: Air traffic controllers keep planes safely apart in the air and on the ground. They use radar, radio and computer systems to guide takeoffs, landings and routes, and warn pilots of weather or other hazards. O*NET rates active listening at 4.38 out of 5 for this job and speaking at 4.25. Most controllers in the U.S. work for the FAA, train at its academy and must start before age 31. The BLS May 2025 median is $148,080 across 22,510 jobs. The work is repetitive and high stakes, since mistakes can have serious consequences.
pay: Air traffic controllers earn a median of $148,080, and the top 10% earn $215,610 or more. Virginia has the highest state median at $191,820, 30% above the national figure, followed by Illinois and Georgia. California has the most controllers, 2,290, and Texas has 2,060 at a median of $170,080.

faq.q: How much do air traffic controllers make?
faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $148,080 a year. The middle half earn between $104,520 and $190,570. Trainees start lower, and the lowest 10% earn under $78,420. Virginia, Illinois ($181,560) and Georgia ($178,420) have the highest state medians, usually at busy centers.

faq.q: Do you need a degree to be an air traffic controller?
faq.a: Not always. In O*NET data, 36% of controllers have a high school diploma, 21% a post-secondary certificate and 20% a bachelor's degree. The FAA accepts work experience or college, then requires its academy, a medical exam and on-the-job training. Most applicants must be under 31.

It can be. In O*NET data the job ranks above 99% of U.S. jobs for repeating the same tasks, and mistakes can have serious consequences. Shifts cover nights, weekends and holidays. Dependability, cautiousness and attention to detail stand out as work styles.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to air traffic controller?
faq.a: The closest moves are power distributors and dispatchers (70% match), Loss Prevention Managers (68%) and Compliance Managers (65%), based on O*NET 31.0. Power dispatchers earn $106,730, 28% less, according to BLS May 2025, and also manage live systems from a control room.
